title: ICAI & ISCA Charting a Future for CA Mobility and AI Readiness

# ICAI & ISCA Charting a Future for CA Mobility and AI Readiness

Ek important update hai. The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI) and the Institute of Singapore Chartered Accountants (ISCA) recently discussed significant steps to enhance Chartered Accountant mobility and prepare the profession for the age of Artificial Intelligence.

The presidents of both institutes exchanged letters on August 21, 2026, formalising their intent to work on two crucial fronts.

Here's what was discussed:

*   **Enhanced CA Mobility:** ICAI and ISCA are progressing towards a full Mutual Recognition Agreement (MRA) of professional qualifications. This MRA aims to provide broader reciprocal recognition, building upon ISCA's earlier move in February 2023 to recognise the ICAI qualification, which allows eligible Indian CAs in Singapore to become ISCA Associate Members. The proposed agreement seeks to open up greater professional opportunities for CAs in both countries.
*   **AI Readiness for the Profession:** Both bodies are exploring collaboration on Artificial Intelligence (AI) capability building for accounting professionals. ISCA signed a Letter of Cooperation for a proposed "Global AI Fluency Initiative" which aims to extend ISCA's AI Fluency Programme to ICAI members and students. This initiative will help in developing relevant AI skills, complementing ICAI's own efforts, which include training over 50,000 members in AI.
*   **Current Status:** Both the MRA and AI collaboration initiatives are currently in the development stage, with their detailed scope and structure to be jointly defined through further discussions.
